scope: NEW 64-agent showcase with exact 3D static potentials and an added hold-only execution adapter; not a paper benchmark, not evidence for unchanged paper algorithm or flight dynamics.
display_time: 0.4 s per retimed phase, a presentation clock, not measured real-time flight
orientation: continuous shortest-angle yaw, hold previous heading while waiting
interpretation: All agents remain in the scene; cameras naturally occlude some. Original spatial paths are unchanged. Continuously audited linear interpolation; no dynamics or real-flight claim. A zero active-neural count must not be presented as evidence for learned improvement.

presentation.moving: Nonzero recorded segment, including vertical travel, and not at goal.
presentation.waiting: Zero displacement and not at goal. Added hold-only scheduling in these two showcases.
presentation.at_goal: Recorded position equals that agent's goal.
presentation.markers: Amber rings are UI indicators, not physical body sizes. Only environment-visible, nonoverlapping hold markers are drawn; counts include all 64 agents.
presentation.pulses: UI-only animation; aircraft positions are untouched.
presentation.clock: Playback time only, neither measured compute time nor physical flight time.
